g.text: Complete lifecycle from partner setup and order booking to production tracking, commercial invoicing, and double-entry general ledger
Configure Active Accounting Period, Chart of Accounts & Office Accounts
Enter Style Name/Ref, Color Breakdown, Quantity, Unit Price & ETD
CustomerOrder observer auto-creates matching FactoryOrder & FactoryFollowup tracker
Generate Customer Invoice with line items, quantities, & prices
Receive Payment into Cash / Bank Office Account; issue receipt voucher
Fabric, knitting, dyeing & accessories expenses posted
Real-time Trial Balance, Balance Sheet & Profit/Loss summary
Monthly Bank Reconciliation ensures zero discrepancy
Assign manufacturing unit, set ETD date, FOB & Sub-contract prices
Submit Pre-Production Sample to Buyer; track comments & approval
• Knitting: Not Started ➔ In Progress ➔ Completed
Shipment Sample approval, finishing, iron & carton packing
Record Actual Delivery Date (AETD); verify on-time status
• Buyer delivery confirmed • Factory contracts settled
• Balanced double-entry ledger • Audit-ready financial records
